title: Preview route record
description: One committed route revision for a session origin, returned by GET /v1/preview/routes/{host}. The front door never caches it.

public_preview_host.description: Lowercase public preview host, without port.

readiness_state.description: Durable readiness of the route. `reconnecting` serves the reconnecting interstitial instead of routing.

port_url.description: Server-held public URL of the Vercel Sandbox runtime's application port. It carries no authority of its own: the runtime admits only requests with a valid route claim and entry token. Never distributed to a browser.

preview_entry_token.description: Activation-scoped token the door places in x-utrace-preview-entry on every forwarded request. The Server SDK accepts a remote traceparent only when it matches, so a syntactically valid traceparent that did not enter through the door is never a parent. Issued per activation and rotated with it; never distributed to a browser.

route_context_signing_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret shared with the preview runtime for this route revision.
